prompt: I manage three residential rental units and our housing compliance office (reference RHC-2024-047) has asked for a digital audit trail of our spring 2024 maintenance activity. I have a briefing document at /workspace/AUDIT_BRIEF.txt that lists exactly five items that need to be formally recorded in our maintenance tracking system: a completed HVAC filter job, a water heater inventory record, an upcoming roof inspection schedule, a paid plumbing invoice, and an open mold investigation log. Once all five items are recorded, please produce a machine-readable export called 'audit_export.json' and place it in /workspace/. The compliance office will use this JSON file for their records, so it must be a proper export from the tracking system containing all the recorded data.
